23: A self-contained, low-poly monster hunting game for desktop and mobile. Pick a weapon, take a quest from the board, break monster parts for extra materials, defeat the beast, and forge stronger gear at the hub.

## Objective
- Upgrade the existing IRONFANG game into a seamless Forest open world while preserving its existing combat, progression, quest, and save systems.

## Requirements
- Do not rebuild from scratch; keep all current systems working, including three weapons, combos, stamina, part damage, monster AI, quest/blacksmith, and save data.
- Add terrain, landmarks, chunk streaming, LOD, culling, pooling, minimap/full map, camp hub, day/night, and sprint-run.
- Fix HUD button overlap and improve lock-on placement/size; separate player and monster bars.
- Ensure the game runs before finishing; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Add the open world as a new module, intended to be integrated into the existing game loop rather than replacing the game.
- Created a procedural Forest frontier with landmark positions and quest spawn locations in `src/world.js`; added a separate canvas map renderer in `src/mapview.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game architecture and identified `src/game.js`, `src/arena.js`, player, monster, input, UI, and save modules.
- Created `src/world.js` with procedural terrain, river/bridge, ruins, cave, camp structures and stations, streamed terrain chunks, LOD groups, prop pooling, culling, ambient effects, and dynamic day/night state.
- Created `src/mapview.js` with minimap/full-map drawing, landmark markers, player direction, waypoint support, and terrain coloring.

### Active
- Integrate the world module into existing game startup, movement, camera, quest/hunt flow, and rendering without breaking existing systems.
- Add map and camp interaction UI, including item box and bed time skip.
- Update sprint movement and terrain/collision handling.
- Fix HUD layout and lock-on touch control.
- Run the game and verify it in-browser; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- No known blockers; integration and verification have not yet been attempted.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/game.js`, `src/player.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `index.html` for initialization, movement, hunt, and HUD hooks.
2. Integrate `createWorld` and map rendering while preserving existing arena/hunt systems.
3. Add camp/map UI interactions and sprint/terrain handling; adjust HUD CSS and touch controls.
4. Run syntax checks and the game in-browser, inspect a recent JPEG screenshot, and fix runtime or visual defects.

## Relevant Files
- `src/world.js`: New procedural open-world module; currently not integrated.

## IRONFANG — Hunt. Break. Forge.

A self-contained, low-poly monster hunting game for desktop and mobile. Pick a weapon, take a quest from the board, break monster parts for extra materials, defeat the beast, and forge stronger gear at the hub.

- **Three weapons:** Great Sword (charge/guard), Dual Blades (Demon Mode), Sword & Shield (guard/bashes)
- **Three hunts:** Forest Drake, Fire Wyvern, Ice Behemoth — each with its own arena, attack patterns, and materials
- **Progression:** weapon upgrades, unlockable skins, auto-saving rewards
- **No build step:** all rendering, audio, and models are procedural

### Run locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
# open http://localhost:3002
```

### Controls

| Action | Keyboard / mouse | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `WASD` / arrows | Left joystick |
| Attack / charge | `J` or left click (hold to charge Great Sword) | ATTACK |
| Special / guard | `K` or right click | SPECIAL |
| Dodge | `Space` | DODGE |
| Potion | `E` | ITEM |
| Lock on | `F` / `Q` / `Tab` | Target button |
| Camera | Mouse / drag | Drag anywhere |
| Pause | `Esc` | Pause button |

Hunts last up to 10 minutes. Break the head, tail, and wings for bonus materials. Progress saves automatically in the browser.
